question: In which year was the first version of the Human Protein Atlas website launched, and on roughly how many antibodies was it based?

tool_uses.name: web_search
tool_uses.input: {"query":"Human Protein Atlas history launch year antibodies"}

turns.text:
The first version of the Human Protein Atlas (version 1.0) was launched in **2005** (specifically released on August 29, 2005) and was based on **718 antibodies** (roughly 700 antibodies) targeting 650 human proteins.

Sources:
- Human Protein Atlas Release History: https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/releases
- Human Protein Atlas History (2005 Launch of the Human Protein Atlas portal): https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/history/2005+Launch+of+the+Human+Protein+Atlas+portal
